page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a woodcut ornament below the text and a catchword at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Esse ro per perdere, zuverlieren seyn.
Particip. perdente, perdenti, die verlierend, verlierenden.
Perduto, perduti, der verlohrne, die verlohrnen.
Perduta, perdute, verlohrnen Seelen, anima, anime.
main_text.head: Gerundij.
main_text.p: Habendo perduto, io, tu, colui, nachdem ich, du, er, verlohren.
Donendo perdere noi, weil wir verlieren sollen oder müssen.
Habendo a perdere, io, tu, &c. weil ich, du, zuverlieren haben.
Essendo per perdere, nachdeme zuverlieren ist.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (cartouche with a face) between the text and the catchword; not transcribed. Black letter and Fraktur not present; German words in roman and italic. Catchword "Vorstell-" read from the foot of the page. Printed first line "Essero" read as "Essero" with long-s ligature; the Greek-like initial glyph was rendered as "Esse".
